summary.text: Kathie Hess Crouse is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 19 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Jim Justice appointed her to the House on November 24, 2021, and she is a realtor.

paragraphs.text: Kathie Hess Crouse graduated from Charleston High School and received an associate degree in 1997 and a B.S. in 2000, with concentrations in microbiology and molecular biology, from West Virginia State University.

She has worked for Dow Chemical as an analytical technician and for the West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources Office of Laboratory Services as a microbiologist and mycologist, and her career experience also includes working as a realtor.
She previously ran for the Putnam County School Board.

Ballotpedia lists her organizational affiliations as including the Kanawha Valley Soap Box Derby, the West Virginia Citizens Defense League, the National Rifle Association, the Putnam County Republican Women and the West Virginia Republican State Executive Committee.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong West Virginian, realtor and delegate representing Putnam County.
She listed her key messages as jobs and economic opportunity, education and school choice, and protecting personal freedoms.
